method.information: Visible-only decisions. Exact RNG/seed/solutions/history are absent from policy inputs. Sampled policy uses independent synthetic draws from its own decision seed, never actual future draws.
method.publicRulesAssumption: The allowed numeric palette is treated as public game rules; its order is fixed. No refill distribution beyond the current controlled-refill rule is inferred from hidden state.

models.visible_score: Highest visible first-wave score, with small layer/green tie preference.
models.visible_coverage: Highest visible first-wave layer gain, then new green cells and capped points.
models.sampled: Four independent counterfactual refill samples; two-ply rollout with visible-coverage follow-up. This is an approximation, not a guarantee.

method.warning: Simulation policy rates are not human win rates. Failure of bounded recovery search does not prove a state unsolvable. Alternative openings are plausible visible deviations, not objectively proven mistakes.
